prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single polished illustrated logo symbol for Noteworthy's AP European History classroom website. The mark should combine an elegantly simplified open book with a sweeping quill rising from its central fold, as one distinctive harmonious symbol suggesting historical inquiry, primary sources, and discovery. Editorial academic identity, refined European bookplate inspiration translated into bold clean contemporary shapes. Handcrafted personality but visually simple enough to read at 48–56 pixels. Warm ivory parchment and muted antique gold, with restrained deep forest-green detailing, for placement on a dark forest-green sidebar (#172d29). Balanced nearly-square composition, symbol fills about 90% of canvas, generous coherent shapes, crisp edges, little interior detail. True transparent background with preserved alpha. Flat illustrated artwork, not a mockup or photograph. NO letters, NO text, NO initials, NO N, NO surrounding box, NO square tile, NO badge border, NO watermark, no gradients or 3D bevels. Deliver one finished 1024x1024 PNG symbol.
